listing.name: Ratchet & Clank (2016) — ratchet-clank-pc (btsouth)
listing.summary: Preview 0.1: every planet loads/plays at 60 FPS preset with cutscenes, sound, controller and saves. No start-to-finish completion. Shadow flicker, first-visit shader stutter and unstable higher frame rates remain. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own base 01.00 decrypted CUSA01073 directory with eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys; no update merged. Extract owned PKG using a recent extractor. Game files remain required at runtime.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the README’s recommended Ratchet-Clank-port-x86_64.AppImage and its adjacent sha256 file. Select your game folder in the launcher; the first start prepares an image and shader caches. Alternatively, build with build.sh and the optional GTK4 launcher. Preserve ~/.local/share/ratchet-port for saves and cache. Only one copy can run at once because they share /tmp/.racS.

warnings: Preview 0.1: every planet loads/plays at 60 FPS preset with cutscenes, sound, controller and saves. No start-to-finish completion. Shadow flicker, first-visit shader stutter and unstable higher frame rates remain.
